::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: second-derivative-test-zero-r
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Three side-by-side plots of a function on x from -1 to 1, each with a
#|   vermilion circle at the origin. The first, x to the fourth, is a blue
#|   U-shaped curve with its lowest point at the origin. The second, minus x
#|   to the fourth, is an upside-down U with its highest point at the origin.
#|   The third, x cubed, rises steadily from lower left to upper right,
#|   flattening at the origin without turning.
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
sdz_x_fk <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 201)
sdz_labels_fk <- c("x^4", "-x^4", "x^3")
sdz_values_fk <- c(sdz_x_fk^4, -sdz_x_fk^4, sdz_x_fk^3)
sdz_n_fk <- length(sdz_x_fk)
sdz_fn_fk <- rep(sdz_labels_fk, each = sdz_n_fk)
sdz_fn_fk <- factor(sdz_fn_fk, levels = sdz_labels_fk)
sdz_x_rep_fk <- rep(sdz_x_fk, 3)
sdz_curves_fk <- tibble::tibble(
  x = sdz_x_rep_fk, value = sdz_values_fk, fn = sdz_fn_fk
)
sdz_origin_fn_fk <- factor(sdz_labels_fk, levels = sdz_labels_fk)
sdz_origin_fk <- tibble::tibble(x = 0, value = 0, fn = sdz_origin_fn_fk)
sdz_aes_fk <- ggplot2::aes(x, value)
ggplot2::ggplot(sdz_curves_fk, sdz_aes_fk) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(colour = "#0072B2") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = sdz_origin_fk, colour = "#D55E00", size = 3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(fn)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "x", y = "function value")
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: second-derivative-test-zero-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Three side-by-side plots of a function on x from -1 to 1, each with a
#|   vermilion circle at the origin. The first, x to the fourth, is a blue
#|   U-shaped curve with its lowest point at the origin. The second, minus x
#|   to the fourth, is an upside-down U with its highest point at the origin.
#|   The third, x cubed, rises steadily from lower left to upper right,
#|   flattening at the origin without turning.
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

sdz_x_fk = np.linspace(-1, 1, 201)
sdz_curves_fk = [sdz_x_fk**4, -(sdz_x_fk**4), sdz_x_fk**3]
sdz_titles_fk = ["$x^4$", "$-x^4$", "$x^3$"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(7, 3), layout="constrained")
for ax, curve, title in zip(axes, sdz_curves_fk, sdz_titles_fk):
    ax.plot(sdz_x_fk, curve, color="#0072B2")
    ax.plot(0, 0, "o", color="#D55E00", markersize=8)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel("x")
axes[0].set_ylabel("function value")
plt.show()
```

:::

This figure shows the [functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $x^4$, $-x^4$ and $x^3$ of @exm-second-derivative-test-zero.
All three have a [flat point](#def-flat-point) at $x = 0$ (circles)
where the [second derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-second-derivative) is $0$:
a [local minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-local-minimizer),
a [local maximizer](#def-local-maximizer),
and neither.

:::
